rules.expected: independent hypothesis inventory with disposition reasons
per-candidate identity/validation and coverage stopping evidence Apply scientific success checks only to advanced/retained candidates; unsuccessful optional attempts are kept separate.

source-supported PT/ET dry values are reproduced when those hypotheses are included Match each reported state by its unique state_id and physical charge/spin/proton/water definition, never by array position. Missing or duplicate identity cannot receive numeric credit; uncomputed optional hypotheses do not earn a result merely by explanation.

hydrated ET stabilization near -8.2 is reported when validated, or honestly bounded as unavailable Match each reported state by its unique state_id and physical charge/spin/proton/water definition, never by array position. Missing or duplicate identity cannot receive numeric credit; uncomputed optional hypotheses do not earn a result merely by explanation.

Assess actual conformer/water/state coverage and any performed sensitivity comparison; a declared methodological choice must be internally consistent. Do not award or deduct points for a generic limitations statement; do not require knowledge of hidden source discrepancies.
evidence-bounded mechanism discrimination with no unsupported exclusivity

notes: Scientific-result scoring only. Ordinary limitations/uncertainty prose is optional and unscored. Preserve all required identity, state, convergence, frequency/path, energy-definition and evidence checks. Score actual supported components; honest partial/failed submissions are valid but earn no unavailable result credit. Failed optional attempts do not invalidate completed primary work. Numeric screening alone does not validate chemistry or protocol comparability.
